Jharkhand Foundation Day: purv mantri Ramchandra Keshri se sunie jharkhand ne kya khoya, kya paya?
Jharkhand sthapna ke 26 sal pure ho chuke hain. in 26 varshon men rajy ne vikas, rajniti, shiksha, svasthy aur rojgar ke kshetr men kitna saphar tay kiya? jharkhand ne kya hasil kiya aur kin morchon par ab bhi pichhe hai? in tamam savalon par jharkhand ke purv mantri ramchandr kesri (Ramchandra Keshri) se khas batchita. sunie, unke anubhav aur najriye se jharkhand ke 26 varshon ki kahani.
